notes: Side-by-side poem, bayts numbered ١) etc. Page 189 starts a new section (no continuation). Words squeezed together without visible spaces in tight hemistichs (e.g. أبحتَ لهُ ما منكَ نجي, كذا الفاروق, أضحوا في الحندس, كي تنبسطي كي تبتهجي) were written as separate words. بسم اللهِ on p.190 written اللَّهِ per §2; لله on p.191 has only the automatic marks. The closing centered hemistich on p.192 is in a :::شعر مشطور block.
